summary: Austrian-raised SS officer Adolf Eichmann organised the deportation of millions of European Jews to Nazi death camps from 1938 to 1945, fled to Argentina, and was captured by Israel in 1960 and hanged in 1962.

evidence.note: family moves to Linz, Austria; childhood and youth there
serves at Dachau in 1934, then transfers to the SD
sent to Vienna after the Anschluss to run forced Jewish emigration
long segment on Theodor Dannecker, Eichmann's deportation deputy
Dannecker and Eichmann organise roundups of Jews in France with French police
Auschwitz-Birkenau becomes the destination for deportation trains
Eichmann coordinates the 1944 mass deportation of Hungarian Jews
escapes via ratline to Argentina and lives under a false name
Mossad agents capture him in Argentina in May 1960
cultivates his fame and nicknames through press coverage as a tool of power

notes: Setting capped at six: Israel (Mossad capture aftermath and Jerusalem trial, a long segment with Arendt) left out in favour of Argentina; also CZ and BG (Dannecker in Bulgaria) have shorter segments. Roles: SS/SD bureaucrat of deportations has no exact role id; military-officer plus politician-official (senior official) is an approximation.
